mapper.insert: INSERT INTO managers (facility_group_id, uuid, email, name, password, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{facilityGroupId}, #{uuid}, #{email}, #{name}, #{password}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET facility_group_id = EXCLUDED.facility_group_id, email = EXCLUDED.email, name = EXCLUDED.name, password = EXCLUDED.password, status = EXCLUDED.status, updated_at = #{updatedAt}
